Name: Volbeat
Flavor-Text: It flashes the light on its rear to communicate with other Volbeat. It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

Name: Illumise
Flavor-Text: It guides Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. There are scholars who research the meaning of these signs.
Effects: If Volbeat is in your discard pile, this attack does 60 more damage.

Name: Snivy
Flavor-Text: It prefers to avoid groups. In its day-to-day life, it dexterously controls its vines to compensate for its short arms.
Effects: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

Name: Servine
Flavor-Text: Servine's one weakness is its inflated sense of pride. It takes a while for Servine to be able to cooperate with other Pokémon.

Name: Serperior
Flavor-Text: An intimidating gaze and majestic appearance have caused this Pokémon to be known as the Lord of the Forest.
Ability-Effect: This Pokémon gets +30 HP for each [G] Energy attached to it.
Effects: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

Name: Team Rocket’s Magmar
Flavor-Text: Wavering flames similar to those of the sun appear on the surface of this Pokémon's body.
Effects: This attack does 50 more damage for each Special Condition affecting your opponent's Active Pokémon.

Name: Team Rocket’s Houndoom

Effects: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Burned.

Name: Fennekin
Flavor-Text: Twigs make for Fennekin's snacks. When it nibbles on twigs, it finds the courage to face strong foes.

Name: Braixen
Flavor-Text: Braixen's branch ignites as it's pulled from the Pokémon's tail. Braixen then uses the flame to spark powerful attacks.

Name: Delphox
Flavor-Text: It controls flames telekinetically, trapping its foes in a fiery vortex surpassing 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit and burning them to a crisp.
Effects: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

Name: Team Rocket’s Lapras
Flavor-Text: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.
Effects: If this Pokémon has more Energy attached than your opponent's Active Pokémon, this attack does 40 more damage.

Name: Team Rocket’s Articuno ex
Effects: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon.

Name: Wingull
Flavor-Text: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.

Name: Pelipper
Flavor-Text: It protects its young in its beak. It bobs on waves, resting on them on days when the waters are calm.

Name: Hisuian Basculin
Flavor-Text: Its ecology is starkly different from that of other Basculin, so theories that it's a totally different species have gained traction in recent years.

Name: Hisuian Basculegion
Flavor-Text: It can jump with incredible power. Parts of its body are tinged red by the rage of its fallen friends.
Effects: This attack does 50 more damage for each point your opponent got during their last turn.

Name: Team Rocket’s Voltorb
Flavor-Text: It's usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

Name: Team Rocket’s Electrode
Flavor-Text: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of the Bomb Ball.
Ability-Effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 70 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.
Effects: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

Name: Team Rocket’s Zapdos ex
Effects: This attack also does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has damage on it.

Name: Blitzle
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon prefers places with lots of lightning strikes. It catches lightning with its mane and stores the electricity within its body.
Effects: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

Name: Zebstrika
Flavor-Text: Once the herd hears thunder, it chases after the storm clouds so that the Blitzle in the group can use the lightning to charge up.

Name: Team Rocket’s Pincurchin
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon is so timid that even brushing against seaweed will make it discharge electricity in surprise. Its lips do not conduct electricity.
Effects: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

Name: Team Rocket’s Slowpoke
Flavor-Text: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.
Effects: Put a random Item card from your discard pile into your hand.

Name: Team Rocket’s Slowking ex
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may draw a card.
Effects: This attack does 20 damage for each card in your hand.

Name: Team Rocket’s Drowzee
Flavor-Text: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

Name: Team Rocket’s Hypno
Flavor-Text: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.
Effects: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. If you do, this attack does 50 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

Name: Team Rocket’s Mr. Mime
Flavor-Text: It's known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

Name: Team Rocket’s Mewtwo
Flavor-Text: The research efforts of a certain scientist ultimately resulted in this Pokémon. Its powers are dedicated to battling.
Effects: This Pokémon also does 70 damage to itself.

Name: Espurr
Flavor-Text: Behind an Espurr's expressionless face is a frantic struggle to contain psychic power.

Name: Meowstic
Flavor-Text: When they sense danger, they exert their psychic power at its maximum output. They have no regard for their opponents.

Name: Oranguru
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon lives quietly in the depths of the forest. The purple, cape-like fur gets longer and longer as Oranguru ages.
Effects: Draw a card.

Name: Gimmighoul
Flavor-Text: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it's actually a Pokémon.

Name: Cubone
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone's dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

Name: Marowak
Flavor-Text: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak's temperament also turned vicious at the same time.
Effects: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has “Team Rocket” in its name, this attack does 70 more damage.

Name: Landorus
Flavor-Text: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.
Effects: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

Name: Team Rocket’s Ekans
Flavor-Text: A very common sight in grasslands and such. It flicks its tongue in and out to sense danger in its surroundings.

Name: Team Rocket’s Arbok
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon is very tenacious. Once it targets its prey, it won't give up the chase, no matter how far the prey goes.
Effects: This attack does 10 more damage for each Energy in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

Name: Team Rocket’s Grimer
Flavor-Text: When two of these Pokémon's bodies are combined together, new poisons are created.
Effects: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

Name: Team Rocket’s Muk
Flavor-Text: It's so stinky! Muk's body contains toxic elements, and any plant will wilt when it passes by.
Effects: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, heal 60 damage from this Pokémon.

Name: Team Rocket’s Koffing
Flavor-Text: The poisonous gases it contains are a little bit lighter than air. That's why it's always slightly airborne.
Effects: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

Name: Team Rocket’s Weezing ex
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Poisoned and Burned.
Effects: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

Name: Team Rocket’s Sneasel
Flavor-Text: This is a smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.
Effects: Flip a coin for each Pokémon you have in play. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

Name: Togedemaru
Flavor-Text: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.
Effects: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

Name: Cufant
Flavor-Text: Cufant can lift loads weighing five tons. In the mornings, it heads into caves with its herd, in search of the ore on which these Pokémon feed.

Name: Copperajah
Flavor-Text: Copperajah are prideful, cantankerous Pokémon. Specimens with vibrant green skin command the respect of others of their kind.

Name: Team Rocket’s Tinkatink
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.

Name: Team Rocket’s Tinkatuff
Flavor-Text: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other's hammers by smashing them together.

Name: Team Rocket’s Tinkaton
Flavor-Text: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.
Effects: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon cost 2 [C] more, and its Retreat Cost is 2 [C] more.

Name: Gible

Effects: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

Name: Gabite

Effects: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

Name: Archaludon
Flavor-Text: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It's so durable that being caught in a cave-in won't faze it.
Effects: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes -30 damage from attacks.

Name: Regidrago
Flavor-Text: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.
Effects: If this Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does -100 damage.

Name: Team Rocket’s Rattata

Effects: This attack does 40 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
